items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: You mean Tubby Hall? Tubby was playing with me, but Ram was running on the SP

ctx.x: Oh yeah? Garland's New Orleans Jazz Band. Uh-huh. Jazz band, yeah.
